name: Boar Head :: A Fairy Tale
source:
Dion, a young traveler,  arrives at the edge of a very strange forest. With no other option, he enters it and braves the thick woods in hopes of reaching the other side. But Dion soon finds himself face to face with the beast of the woods, known as The Boar. 

The two strike a deal, The Boar will lead Dion through the forest safely: in return he must give her something "Most Preciouses." For what reason is unknown,  but as the two travel through the forest, they will soon find that what is deemed preciouses is not always shiny.

[from [url=https://zodiacstories.itch.io/boar-head-a-fairy-tale]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
年轻的旅行者迪翁来到一片非常奇怪的森林边缘。在别无选择的情况下，他进入了那里，勇敢地穿过茂密的树林，希望到达另一边。但迪翁很快发现自己与森林中的野兽“野猪”面对面。

两人达成协议，野猪将带领迪翁安全穿过森林：作为回报，他必须给她一些“最珍贵的东西”。原因不得而知，但当两人穿越森林时，他们很快就会发现，所谓的宝石并不总是闪闪发光的。

[来自[url=https://zodiacstories.itch.io/boar-head-a-fairy-tale]itch.io[/url]]
